title: Coolant and Water Pump Leaks
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on coolant leakage and water pump issues, with one case of a resolved no-leak finding and several examples that are too unclear or off-topic to determine sentiment confidently.

positive.summary: The positive review describes follow-up inspection finding no coolant loss or active leak after checking the vehicle and coolant level.

negative.summary: The negative review reports a leaking mechanical water pump, including a warning to add coolant and replacement of the pump with its bracket assembly.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined reviews mention coolant loss after a cooling-fan problem and a roof water leak, but the available fragments do not support a clear sentiment summary for this topic.

limitations: The topic includes at least one fragment about a roof water leak that appears unrelated to coolant or water pump issues.
There is only one positive review and one negative review with known sentiment, so examples are limited.
